findings.result: Strict206 response, exact Content-Range start/end/total, expected Content-Length when supplied, byte count and identity encoding enforced. Strict stream prevents skipping past received prefix and records a stop at PixelData. Deflated transfer syntax is explicitly rejected before decompression.

All three UIDs checked in parsed headers; pinned inventory supplies expected full size and SHA256/LFS OID, with LFS batch object membership/size checked. Full-file SHA is checked only if complete small object received.

Manifest binds selection, inventory hashes, revision and code. Checkpoint payload digests are verified on resume; final summary count alone is insufficient independent membership proof, so separate validator checks unique exact inventory endpoints and full success/failure partition against checkpoint.

Original summary handles within-series side/PatientID differences and within-study candidates. Independent validation additionally joins hashed PatientID across studies, checks source-sized pixel boundary feasibility, flags description/IOP plane disagreements and selected header geometry variations. These are candidate signals, not automatic conclusions.

Raw prefix bytes are discarded. Final audit can verify file/checkpoint integrity and recorded prefix-history consistency, but cannot recompute most prefix digests or authenticate unreceived full-file suffixes. Top-level whitelist excludes nested per-frame metadata, post-PixelData fields and middle slices.

geometry_reference.title: DICOM PS3.3 2026d C.7.6.2 Image Plane Module
geometry_reference.use: Row/column direction cosines define the image plane; unit/orthogonality constraints and vector cross product determine plane normal. Independent0.90 dominance and0.002 numeric tolerances are conservative candidate-extraction choices, not a DICOM classification standard.
